name: Meadgard
description:
About This Game

The Norse gods are coming to your tavern; and they expect the best seat in the house.

In Meadgard, you and up to three friends are unlikely innkeepers in a world crawling with mythological chaos. You have one shot at glory: build the greatest Viking tavern the Nine Realms have ever seen and earn a place at Valhalla’s legendary feast.

Every morning sends you into the wild to hunt, forage, and fight for ingredients. Every evening the doors open, the mead flows, and the mayhem begins.

Crafted by Oddiko, the studio backed by the founders of Arrowhead Games Studios.

Hunt by Day

Tonight’s feast won’t cook itself.

Leave the tavern behind and venture into dangerous wilds to hunt and fight mythical creatures, raid camps, gather ingredients, and uncover hidden treasures. Fight trolls with frying pans, dodge swarms of mischievous nissar, and haul your loot home before opening time.

Serve by Night

When the tavern doors open, the real battle begins.

Cook meals, pour drinks, entertain guests, and stop your customers from tearing the place apart. Vikings get loud, and Norse gods expect five-star service every single time. Oh and watch out for those coin thief Goblins…

Build the greatest Tavern Valhalla has ever seen! 

Turn your crumbling alehouse into a legendary gathering hall.

Unlock recipes, brew strange potions, grow crops, craft weapons, decorate your tavern, and recruit quirky townsfolk with powerful upgrades and stories of their own.

Key Features:

• Chaotic co-op for 1-4 players
Work together to run the tavern - or scream at each other while everything catches fire.

• Hunt monsters for ingredients
Fight mythical creatures and drag your hard-earned supplies back home before nightfall.

• Run a Viking tavern under pressure
Cook meals, pour mead, entertain guests, and survive increasingly demanding customers.

• Face the Norse gods themselves
Impress legendary visitors or suffer the consequences of divine disappointment.

• Upgrade Valhalla
Customise your tavern and unlock new weapons, shops, cosmetics, crops and recipes.

• A Norse mythology adventure with heart
Meet bizarre creatures, eccentric villagers, and gods with surprisingly personal problems.

Meadgard is coming to Steam — wishlist now to be notified on launch!

Join the crew on Discord for development updates, sneak peeks, and the chance to shape the game before it ships. Cheers!
short_desc: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op adventure where you and your friends create the ultimate Viking tavern. Hunt mystical beasts by day, cook and serve rowdy patrons by night, and survive the wrath of Norse gods when the mead stops flowing.
